name: Call API
description: Outbound HTTP call. URL and headers can be literal or JSONPath; body supports ${...} placeholders that resolve from request / context / iteration frames. Required: url, method, timeoutMs.

params.name: url
params.description: Absolute URL. Literal or $.path that resolves to a string.

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Hard timeout per call in milliseconds. Mandatory — use 5000 for typical lookups, 30000 only for slow upstreams.

params.name: headers
params.description: Header map. Each value is literal or $.path. Add Authorization here for downstream services.

params.name: body
params.description: Request body shape — typically a JSON object with ${$.foo} placeholders.

params.name: responseMap
params.description: Optional projection — pick which response fields to expose downstream as `{ key: $.responseField }`.

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: Emits the parsed response body (or the responseMap projection).
